name: Miracle of the Dragon
material: Hanging scroll; ink, color, and gold on silk
summary: Buddhist disciples are grouped around a dragon in the lower right part of the scroll. The figures' varying levels of composure at the miraculous appearance of the dragon indicates how far removed each figure is from worldly affairs.
